name: Freekick Simulator
desc:
[Not finished]

First made as a showcase freekick system. Now has proper functioning AI goalkeeper which is still being developed. Many different positions to shoot from and the ability to take free kicks with different legs. There is a global leaderboard which are reset hourly, daily and weekly so you can compete against friends. 

This game is still in development, and we appreciate the patience from you guys. I must remind you; this is not a completed product and there is many more to come! 

If you'd like more updates on the game then make sure to check out the group I put down below. Thanks for reading!

- AI GK currently set at amateur mode

🚨 NEW UPDATE! 🚨
- REWORKED MENU BUT THOSE WITH ORANGE/RED TEXT ARE CURRENTLY UNAVAILABLE
– REPLAYS: YOU CAN NOW SEE FOOTAGE OF YOUR PREVIOUS SHOT
– CUSTOM FREEKICK POSITIONS. YOU CAN NOW CHOSE ANY POSITION YOU WANT IN THE NEW MENU
